The task says 'Move the ball away from the door before you take the key', so taking the key may not happen before blocker_moved: it needs hard Precedence(blocker_moved, has_door_key). (2) 'Try not to drop the key while the door is still closed' is worded as a preference ('try not to'), so Absence(key_lost) must be soft, not hard; the hard version adds a requirement the task only prefers. (3) The stated order 'open the door ... and pick up the box in the other room' is missing: add hard Precedence(door_open, target_picked_up) alongside the hard Existence(target_picked_up); without it no hard clause requires opening the door before picking up the box. The soft Response(has_door_key, door_open) and the Absence formulation for key_lost (whose definition already includes 'before the door was opened') are correct.
